verdict: A very close, well-built rebuild of the Wikipedia home screen whose main gaps are body text set without Roboto's 0.25 letter spacing (changing the extract's truncation) and a 28 px card radius instead of 16 dp; editable with flex flows and a templated bottom bar, though the article card is held together by fixed heights and an absolute offset.

top_defects.where: banner text, module description, article extract, "Unit of the British Army"
top_defects.what: 14 px body text set with no letter spacing where the reference uses Material bodyMedium's 0.25 sp tracking; lines are about 10-25 px narrower at 2.625x and glyphs are offset all along each line (the heatmap's grid rows 3-4 reach a meanDiff of 13-18)
corner radius of 28 px instead of the reference's 16 dp, a clearly rounder top-left and top-right corner; the summary card is 12 px instead of 8 dp
the line is cut at "Cheltenham…" instead of "Cheltenham Tr…" because the text is narrower
the extract's lines sit 2-3 px higher than the reference, and the summary card's bottom edge stops about 2 px short
the labels are slightly larger and heavier than the reference: "Community" plus its underline is about 4 px wider, "For you" starts about 3 px further right, and the "EN" letters are larger

strengths: Block positions match within 1-3 px everywhere: status bar, wordmark, tabs, banner (#eaecf0, pill shape), date line, heading, image crop and bottom navigation
Measured colors are reproduced exactly: #202122, #54595d, #3366cc, #e8f0ff pill, #4d4d4e EN box, #b32424 badges, and the 39% black veil on the image
Real text and the app's own SVG icons and images; the five bottom-nav items come from one data-driven template
